title: Sabbatical Lock Off 2 Cottage Seaside, FL
meta_description: Sabbatical Lock Off 2 is a 2 BR / 2 BA / 6 Guest cottage in Seaside, FL. Elegant and classically inspired with arched doorways and vaulted ceilings, Sabbatical will simply delight!
description_expanded: Description14 West Ruskin2 QUEEN BEDSA Relaxing Seaside Retreat Steps from the BeachFitting name, isn’t it? If your time in Seaside, Florida is meant for rest, renewal, and slowing down, there’s truly no better place than Sabbatical. This bright white coastal cottage offers a serene escape just moments from the beach and captures the relaxed elegance Seaside is known for. From the moment you arrive, Sabbatical invites you to leave the stresses of everyday life behind and settle into vacation mode.Inviting Interiors with Coastal CharmAs you step inside, you’re welcomed by one of the most beautiful interiors in Seaside. The main living area is light-filled and thoughtfully designed, featuring a comfortable sofa that doubles as a sleeper, two plush accent chairs, and a large flat-screen TV—perfect for unwinding after a sun-soaked day. Tucked nearby, two additional chairs sit beside built-in bookcases and a decorative fireplace, creating an ideal nook for reading or enjoying a quiet moment indoors.Sunlit Kitchen and Dining SpacesAdjacent to the living area, the dining and kitchen space is surrounded by windows that flood the room with natural light. Open the windows to let in the coastal breeze while preparing a fresh Florida-inspired meal. The kitchen is fully equipped with stainless steel appliances and a high-top bar, making it both functional and welcoming for casual dining or entertaining.Comfortable Bedrooms for Restful NightsThe first floor is completed by two queen bedrooms, each offering a private ensuite bathroom with a shower. These thoughtfully appointed rooms provide privacy and comfort, making them perfect for couples or guests traveling together.Upstairs Living with Gulf ViewsUpstairs, guests will find a second, modern kitchen featuring a double oven and induction stovetop, along with a spacious dining table ideal for gathering. Just off the kitchen and dining area is an open-air balcony where you can enjoy Gulf views, morning coffee, or evening cocktails as the sun sets over Seaside.Whether you’re enjoying peaceful mornings on the porch, breezy afternoons cooking with the windows open, or evenings soaking in the coastal ambiance, Sabbatical Lock Off 2 offers the perfect balance of comfort, style, and location for an unforgettable Seaside vacation.Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign registration. 3-night minimum Fall | 2-night minimum WinterFEATURESSeaside Private Residential Beach at West Ruskin Pavilion1-minute walk (56 feet) to beach accessFront porch with porch swingPrivate balcony with Gulf viewsWasher & dryerSmart TVs throughout the homePeacock Alley Linens – fresh, luxurious towels and sheets throughoutAccess to 3 swimming pools, 5 clay tennis courts, 3 pickleball courts (court fees apply), and a fitness centerWelcome tote with two beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and two complimentary rental bikes for pickup at the Seaside Transit AuthorityPersonalized service throughout your stayStarter amenities providedParking: One parking pass issued for one-bedroom cottages; two parking passes issued for two-bedroom and larger homes. A golf cart is considered a car. Golf carts for non-homeowners visiting Seaside are prohibited. Special circumstances and medical needs require a golf cart permit.No pets allowedSTR23-002297
